desc: The Citori 825 Feather is a Lightweight, low profile upland hunting shotgun with an alloy receiver. Featuring durable steel breech face and hinge pin; Inflex II recoil pad; Ivory bead sight; silver nitride finish; Fire-Lite 2 Trigger; Invector-DS Flush chokes; high-relief game scene engraving and oil finish Grade II/III walnut stock. Includes three chokes.
